details: Bitcoin dropped to $79,700, marking a 2.2% decline in 24 hours, as the U.S. issued advisories for Qatar and Lebanon, citing increased security concerns and Iranian threats against U.S. personnel in the Middle East. This surge in geopolitical uncertainty has triggered a broader downturn across major cryptocurrencies, including Ether, XRP, and Solana.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K Amid Escalating Mideast Tensions

details: Italian authorities arrested 30 individuals this week, dismantling a mafia-linked underground bank that allegedly laundered approximately €68 million (around $76.29 million USD) through cryptocurrencies, fake invoices, and cross-border transfers. The operation involved connections to Spain and Switzerland, with the network operating from a car-rental business near Milan and tied to 'Ndrangheta and Casalesi Clan groups.
title: Italian Police Bust Mafia-Linked Crypto Money Laundering Network

details: U.S. and European regulators are closely scrutinizing decentralized finance (DeFi) "vaults," which have attracted over $10 billion in deposits by offering high yields. Regulators are concerned about the opaque, high-risk nature of these platforms and how their curators operate under existing financial regulations, leading to calls for adapting traditional financial frameworks to mitigate systemic risks within the rapidly expanding sector.
title: US, European Regulators Raise Concerns Over Risky DeFi Vaults
